import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t))
    lnK = p[4] + p[5]*t
    h = p[6] + p[7]*t
    return base / (1 + np.exp(lnK) * np.abs(A)**h)
